'''Derek Hwong''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Normal DPC warm-up tournament]] on 23 February 2001 with [[Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|SYCFA / space stuff]], according to Geoff Snider's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1790">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-25-geoffs-dpc-warmupd1790/ geoffs-dpc-warmup], DeckTech (Geoff "gsiva" Snider, 25 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-25-geoffs-dpc-warmupd1790/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
